inlines.v: EX'CRETORY, adjective Having the quality of excreting or throwing off excrementitious matter by the glands. EX'CRETORY, noun A little duct or vessel, destined to receive secreted fluids, and to excrete them; also, a secretory vessel. The excretories are nothing but slender slips of the arteries, deriving an appropriated juice from the blood.
